title: The Swapped Spotlight Cup
intro: Minutes before the talent show finale, the winner's gleaming prize cup is gone, and a plastic copy sits in its place on the stage table.

suspects.name: Jonah
suspects.line: I was judging, not wandering. Clipboard says so.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: I only came backstage to find a charger.

suspects.name: Lena
suspects.line: I was in the bathroom doing my makeup, duh.

suspects.name: Maya
suspects.line: I was tuning my guitar all afternoon, honest!

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Ask the lighting crew, they saw me all night.

clues.text: Someone left a smudge on the mirror that matches a grey hoodie, so the culprit is not the one in the grey hoodie.
Crumbs were found beside the spot where the culprit was last seen, which is not the front row, so that seat is cleared.
A thread of sparkly red jacket fabric snagged on the coat rack hook, so the culprit was wearing that jacket.
Clean black sneaker prints show the culprit did not wear black sneakers, so those shoes can be ruled out.
